facts.statement: In-game community events were expected to run on Tuesdays at 09:00 and 16:00 Pacific Time, Thursdays at 15:00 Pacific Time, and Friday mornings at 09:00 Pacific Time.
facts.quote: se espera que los eventos de juego ocurran todos los martes a las 09:00 hrs. y 16:00 hrs. TP

article_summaries.title: Campamento de Verano – Semana de Artesanías (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official freerealms.com news post for the Summer Camp event, focused on its Crafting Week theme. It gives the expected in-game event schedule (Tuesdays, Thursdays and Fridays, Pacific Time) and explains how to reach events through the in-game Game Guide calendar and teleport. The post is dated only as 'Posted 10 months, 3 weeks ago' in the capture, so no absolute date can be established.
